notes: The colophon names no one. It gives only the canto title (pārvatīsaṃbhogavarṇana sarga, i.e. canto 8), a garbled note that the scribe wrote it ("iti mama likhyeteḥ (!)", 'thus written by me'), and a blessing ("śubha sarvadāṃ"). There is no date, place, king or author named in it (Kālidāsa is not mentioned). The catalogue fields are empty, so there is nothing to conflict with.
